title: helichrysum melaleucum subsp. roseum
intro: Helichrysum melaleucum subsp. roseum, commonly known as the Rosy Everlastings or Helichrysum roseum, is a flowering plant species within the Asteraceae family, also known as the daisy or sunflower family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, making it useful in wound healing and skin care. The therapeutic actions of Helichrysum melaleucum subsp. roseum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and terpenes, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immune-modulating effects. The bioactive constituents and therapeutic actions of this plant make it a valuable resource for traditional medicine and natural remedies.
